claude.sample_unit: synthetic avulsion scenarios (each in 4 prompt formats, evaluated twice by 4 models)

links.outcome: Effect of prompt format variation and 48-h repeat runs on LLM prognosis outputs
links.effect: Prompt format significantly influenced outputs (clinical-practical closest to experts, narrative weakest); short-term stability generally maintained with small but statistically detectable shifts in some model-format combinations.
links.quote: Prompt format significantly influenced outputs, with the clinical-practical format showing the closest alignment and the narrative format the weakest.

links.effect: Prompt format significantly influenced outputs; clinical-practical format had closest alignment and narrative was weakest.

links.effect: Gemini and ChatGPT-4o were most balanced; Claude deviated more in absolute severity; DeepSeek had lower categorical concordance.
links.quote: Gemini and ChatGPT-4o showed the most balanced performance, whereas Claude preserved relative risk ordering with greater deviation in absolute severity, and DeepSeek demonstrated lower categorical concordance.

links.effect: Meaningful agreement overall, but performance varied by model, with Claude severity deviation and DeepSeek lower categorical concordance.
